preconditions.description: The number of songs n must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 100000.
The length of the initial song s_0 must be between 1 and 100.
The length of the string t must be equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n for k in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query index k must be between 0 and n.
Each sailor's name w must be a non-empty string.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of occurrences of w in s_k modulo 10^9+7.
